sentences.text: Next week I will go to Beijing with my parents.
sentences.translation: 下周我将和爸爸妈妈一起去北京。

chunks.label: 主干(主谓宾)
chunks.text: I will go to Beijing with my parents

grammar.name: will + 动词原形
grammar.note: will go 表示"将要/打算去",will 后接动词原形,构成一般将来时。

grammar.note: next week 是将来时间状语,常与 will 连用。

sentences.text: We will take a plane early in the morning and stay in a hotel.
sentences.translation: 我们将一大早坐飞机去,然后住在一家旅馆里。

chunks.text: We will take a plane early in the morning and stay in a hotel

sentences.text: We will visit the Great Wall, the Palace Museum and the zoo.
sentences.translation: 我们将参观长城、故宫博物院和动物园。

chunks.text: We will visit the Great Wall, the Palace Museum and the zoo

grammar.note: will visit 表示"将要参观"。专有名词 the Great Wall 前要用定冠词 the。

sentences.translation: 我们将吃北京烤鸭,尝尝当地的美食。
